feeds.title: Journey Church Hawaii Blog
feeds.description: Journey Church Hawaii is a Jesus-loving, Bible-believing church that exists to equip people to discover, develop, live, and share God's Abundant Life through a network of MiniChurches (small groups) and regular gatherings at Church.

feeds.title: The of Journey Church Blog
feeds.description: Journey Church has been spreading the Gospel and helping those in need in and around Davidson County, NC since 2011. Our church provides a family environment, offering multiple services for adults and kids of all age

feeds.title: Bobby's Thursday Blog
feeds.description: Journey Church exists to create an irresistible passion for God and for people who are seeking Him. We strive to be culturally relevant. Our faith is put into action in every aspect of our lives. We are a mission-driven church, with the ultimate goal of bringing others to Jesus. We believe everyone was created for a purpose and has been given gifts by God to further His Kingdom on earth!

feeds.title: The Journey Church Blog
feeds.description: We're a community of real people who prioritize connecting regularly to help each other trust and follow Jesus. We're here to help you meet Jesus, not to convince you to join our specific church. Our goal is to help you develop a relationship with Jesus and use your gifts to serve.

feeds.title: Colorado Journey Church Blog
feeds.description: We help people take their next steps with Jesus. We do this by helping them Know God on a personal level, Find Freedom through a redemptive-community, and Discover Purpose for how God created them in order to Make A Difference in their world.

feeds.title: Journey Church TN
feeds.description: We are a community being shaped by Jesus experiencing and practicing humility, curiosity, belonging, and generosity. We hope to be people who embrace the way of Jesus by listening first, speaking second, loving freely, and giving generously.

feeds.title: Journey Church Chattanooga Blog
feeds.description: Journey Church is a place for people who aren't perfect but are on a journey to become what God created them for. You can indeed 'come as you are' to our events or services. Journey Church is where you can belong and become so much more.

feeds.title: Journey Community Church Blog
feeds.description: At Journey Community Church, we think church should be different. We think everyone should feel welcome - that church should be the most genuine place on earth. In fact, we don't really care what you wear, who you voted for in the last election, or what kind of people you hang out with. We think everyone should be welcome at church. If you want to know our 'line in the sand,' it's grace. It is our mission to help ordinary people disconnected from God access the depth of life 'with God' through Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Journey Church Des Moines Blog
feeds.description: We believe that the mission of Jesus, the mission to 'go and make disciples,' is the mission of every church. We also believe that every church should be committed to the clear teaching of Scripture and to doing the work of Christ in their community and the world. In addition to these things, we believe that each church has a unique set of values, things that they are passionate about, that make it a unique expression of the body of Christ.

feeds.title: Christ Journey Church Blog
feeds.description: Christ Journey is on a mission beyond the walls of our physical campuses. Our hope is to see lives changed in Miami and around the globe. It is an ongoing effort made possible with the help of local and global partnerships, a generous church, and God's leading.

feeds.title: On the Journey Church Blog
feeds.description: We are a group that has a heart for the Church and a desire to see it unified in bigger, better, and more beautiful ways. From pastors to business entrepreneurs to authors, to everyday lovers of Jesus, our goals are the same - interconnect the Body of Christ, lift each other up, and empower everyone to walk in their Kingdom destiny. On this site, you can find wisdom and revelation shared by the topic, church, or author.

feeds.title: The Journey Delaware
feeds.description: We're a real church for real people - which means we want you to come as you are and be who you are. Regardless of what the world tells you that you are, you are welcome here. Our mission is simple: we help people find Jesus and follow him fully. Everything we do flows out of our passion to see people give their lives to Jesus and then point their lives in his direction. We believe this happens in three key environments: Gather, Connect, and Serve.

feeds.title: TC Journey Church Blog
feeds.description: TC Journey is a Traverse City church community of Christ-followers where the Word of God, hospitality, and evangelism are woven into one common thread. When you walk through our doors, you will sense a welcoming spirit of warmth, friendliness, and acceptance that lives in every area of our ministry. At TC Journey, we teach biblical truth to develop the spiritual maturity of our attenders.

feeds.title: Journey Christian Church Blog
feeds.description: Journey Christian Church strives to call people to become fully devoted followers of Jesus and to live out the values and realities of the book of Acts. It is our intent to function less like and institution and more like a family, and we recognize that families encourage one another and seek relational solutions to problems

feeds.title: Journey With Us Blog
feeds.description: In January of 2021, Journey made a radical change: We stopped being a local church to instead serve to help foster a regional movement. We launched a new church with a focus on the people and not the platform. As much as we said, Church was never intended to be a service in a building but a people on a mission. Our focus now is encouraging the church at large, without being a 'church' (as we know it). We believe that regardless of what congregation you're a part of - or if you've given up on that completely - you are still the church. All of us are. And we need each other.

feeds.title: West MI Journey Church Blog
feeds.description: We are a church focused on relationships. You can get a religious experience anywhere. We focus on taking steps in our relationships and we believe that God wants to have a personal relationship with us. Explore our site to get more insight into how you can explore or take steps to experience God. You can also read more about our church, history & our statement of faith in our blog.

feeds.title: The Journey Church Online Blog
feeds.description: We encourage God-given dreams and believe our community can be a natural habitat for God's dream of a healed world to grow on you. Our team is made up of families, leaders, and friends who share a vision for God's Kingdom dream, values, and the ways of Jesus.
